lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.form.future: It can't be in the future
lifecycle.empty.noMatchBody: Try other filters or clear them.
lifecycle.kindHint.verbal_warning: A first, spoken word about it
lifecycle.kindHint.written_warning: On record: the employee confirms it in the app
lifecycle.kindHint.reprimand: An official sanction, kept on file
lifecycle.fineStatus.approved: approved, comes off the next payslip
lifecycle.nextStep.written_warning: If it happens again, the next step is a written warning.
lifecycle.nextStep.final_warning: If it happens again, the next step is a final warning.
lifecycle.nextStep.consider_termination: A final warning is in force: another breach can end the employment.
lifecycle.discipline.description: Warnings and reprimands, the fines proposed with them, and what the employee says.
lifecycle.discipline.emptyBody: When something goes wrong, record it here: the employee reads it in the app and can explain.
lifecycle.record.newHint: The employee reads it in the app, confirms it and can write an explanation.
lifecycle.record.descriptionHint: Facts only: what, where and when. The employee reads this.
lifecycle.record.descriptionPlaceholder: For example: insulin left out of the fridge from 14:00 to 17:30 on Saturday.
lifecycle.record.evidenceHint: A photo of the thermometer log, the receipt, a screenshot
lifecycle.record.proposeFineHint: It goes to Payroll as a proposal; it comes off the payslip only once approved there.
lifecycle.record.fineNote: The employee sees the proposed fine and can dispute it.
lifecycle.record.fineHidden: The amount is for people who see salaries.
lifecycle.record.noExplanation: No explanation yet. The employee can write one in the app.
lifecycle.record.expiresHint: Afterwards it no longer counts for the next step
lifecycle.record.withdrawBody: It stops counting for {name}. A proposed fine is cancelled in Payroll.
lifecycle.suspensions.description: Who is suspended, until when and why. Their record stays; the bot and the app leave them alone.
lifecycle.suspensions.daysLeft: {n} days left | {n} day left | {n} days left
lifecycle.suspensions.emptyNowBody: Everyone who works here has their access.
lifecycle.suspend.title: Suspend someone
lifecycle.suspend.description: Pause their access for a while. Their data, task history and pay setup stay.
lifecycle.suspend.lastDayHint: Access comes back by itself the day after
lifecycle.suspend.reasonPlaceholder: For example: the cash shortage is being checked
lifecycle.suspend.effects: Meanwhile they get no routine tasks, reminders or announcements; the bot only says their access is paused.
lifecycle.reinstate.title: Reinstate {name}?
lifecycle.reinstate.body: Access comes back now, with the same role and branches.
lifecycle.person.suspendHint: Pause their access for a while
lifecycle.person.counting: {n} records count from the last 6 months | {n} record counts from the last 6 months | {n} records count from the last 6 months
lifecycle.person.notSuspended: Not suspended: their access is open.
lifecycle.person.changeJobHint: A new position, branch, department or pay from a day
lifecycle.countdown.inDays: in {n} days | in {n} day | in {n} days
lifecycle.countdown.ago: {n} days ago | {n} day ago | {n} days ago
lifecycle.leaving.description: Requests to leave from the app, last days agreed with their handover, and the people who left with their final payslip.
lifecycle.leaving.emptyBody.requested: When someone asks to leave in the app, the request waits here for you to agree their last day.
lifecycle.leaving.emptyBody.agreed: An agreed last day shows here with its handover list until that evening.
lifecycle.leaving.emptyBody.completed: People who left show here with their final payslip and what they handed over.
lifecycle.leaving.emptyBody.closed: Requests someone withdrew, or that were declined, stay here.
lifecycle.leaving.notice: Notice: {n} days | Notice: {n} day | Notice: {n} days
lifecycle.leaving.declineBody: They read your reason in the app and stay on the team: {name}.
lifecycle.leaving.withdrawBody: They stay on the team and read your reason in the app: {name}.
lifecycle.leaving.evening: On the evening of the last day ({date}, {time} or after their last shift) their access ends, their work goes back, the contract ends and Payroll prepares the final payslip.
lifecycle.leaving.blockersBody: These don't stop the leaving; whatever is still open that evening stays on record.
lifecycle.leaving.finalPayslipOn: Yes, {n} unused leave days paid out | Yes, {n} unused leave day paid out | Yes, {n} unused leave days paid out
lifecycle.leaving.finalPayslipNone: No final payslip: they had no pay setup, or it was switched off.
lifecycle.leaving.notesPlaceholder: How it went, what to remember if they come back
lifecycle.leaving.notesHint: Only HR sees these; the person never does.
lifecycle.leaving.readOnly: Only people who may run leavings change this.
lifecycle.runStatus.draft: A draft for Payroll to check
lifecycle.agree.title: Agree the last day: {name}
lifecycle.agree.description: They hear the day in the bot and the handover list is made. On that day's evening they leave and Payroll prepares their final payslip.
lifecycle.agree.shortNotice: That gives {n} days of notice, less than the usual two weeks: agree it with them. | That gives {n} day of notice, less than the usual two weeks: agree it with them. | That gives {n} days of notice, less than the usual two weeks: agree it with them.
lifecycle.agree.finalPayslipHint: A draft through the last day, for Payroll to check and pay.
lifecycle.agree.leaveDays: Unused leave days to pay out
lifecycle.agree.leaveDaysHint: Count them from their leave records; Payroll can change it on the draft.
lifecycle.start.title: Start a leaving
lifecycle.start.description: The last day is agreed at once and they hear it in the bot: for a resignation handed in on paper, the company ending the work or a contract running out.
lifecycle.start.lastDayHint: On its evening they leave and Payroll prepares the final payslip
lifecycle.start.reasonPlaceholder: For example: the fixed-term contract ends and isn't renewed
lifecycle.start.error.past: The last day can't be in the past
lifecycle.handover.title: Handover
lifecycle.handover.hint: Tick each item off once it is handed over.
lifecycle.handover.closedNote: The list closed when they left.
lifecycle.handover.kind.keys: Keys: the pharmacy, the safe and the cabinets
lifecycle.handover.takenBack: Taken back in Assets on their last day
lifecycle.handover.tasksOpen: {n} open tasks go back to whoever gave them | {n} open task goes back to whoever gave it | {n} open tasks go back to whoever gave them
lifecycle.handover.equipmentHint: Equipment ticked off is taken back in Assets on their last day; the rest stays on record with them.
lifecycle.handover.empty: The list is made when the last day is agreed.
lifecycle.handover.addPlaceholder: For example: the narcotics register to Farrux
lifecycle.exit.title: Their answers before they go
lifecycle.exit.none: No answers yet: they can answer a few questions in the app before their last day.
lifecycle.event.completed: The last day was over: they left
lifecycle.changes.description: New positions, branches, departments and pay from a day: once approved they apply by themselves and show in the person's history.
lifecycle.changes.emptyBody.proposed: A change someone proposes waits here for whoever may approve it.
lifecycle.changes.emptyBody.upcoming: Approved changes wait here for their day, then apply by themselves.
lifecycle.changes.emptyBody.applied: Changes that took effect show here and in each person's history.
lifecycle.changes.emptyBody.closed: Changes that were turned down or called off stay here.
lifecycle.changes.payHidden: The pay changes; the amounts are for people who see salaries.
lifecycle.changes.roleNote: The access a job title brings follows only as far as whoever approves it may give.
lifecycle.changes.errorTitle: It couldn't take effect on its day
lifecycle.propose.title: Propose a job change
lifecycle.propose.description: Pick what changes and from which day. Once approved it applies by itself that day and shows in their history.
lifecycle.propose.pickPerson: Choose a person to see their job today and pick what changes.
lifecycle.propose.branchHint: Their home branch; the old one comes off their branches.
lifecycle.propose.overlap: A change from {date} already waits for them: this one would clash with it.
lifecycle.propose.reasonPlaceholder: For example: two years' experience and a higher pharmaceutical degree
lifecycle.propose.approveHint: You may decide it: it takes effect on its day without waiting for anyone.
lifecycle.propose.waits: It waits for someone who may approve it: they see it in Needs you.
lifecycle.propose.error.past: Pick today or a later day
lifecycle.propose.error.nothing: Pick at least one thing that changes
lifecycle.career.title: Career
lifecycle.career.description: Their working life here: job changes, pay and leaving, newest first.
lifecycle.career.emptyBody: Promotions, transfers and pay changes show here once they are approved.
lifecycle.soon.title: In the making
lifecycle.soon.org.line: Departments, their heads and who reports to whom, as one tree.
lifecycle.soon.org.body: See the whole company at a glance, with open vacancies as dashed places; drag a person to propose a move.
lifecycle.soon.equipment.line: Uniforms, keys and devices: who has what, and what comes back when they leave.
lifecycle.soon.equipment.body: Issue an item with a photo, the employee confirms it in the app, and leaving asks for it back.
lifecycle.soon.reviews.line: Review rounds with self and manager answers, goals and the outcome.
lifecycle.soon.reviews.body: Open a round, everyone answers a few questions about their work, the manager adds theirs, and a raise or a bonus follows from it.
